title: ICE ELITE geographic prioritization, M-J-M-A-, and prospective judicial counterpower
question: Can one person in a Palantir-attributed deployment be traced from representation and threshold through institutional use, action, consequence, evidence access, pause, remedy, correction and residual injury without collapsing geographic prioritization into individual identification or vendor development into field authority?

propositions.claim: ELITE materially informed geographic selection for the October 30, 2025 Woodburn operation.
propositions.support: The judicial record describes ELITE-supported identification of a denser geographic target, and official oversight records preserve the same testimony and seek the underlying technical and contractual records.
counterevidence: field-office intelligence also contributed to location selection
the production configuration, queries, map outputs and active data sources are not public
independent reporting rather than a completed agency technical audit supplies the Palantir development attribution
propositions.falsifier: Operation records show that ELITE was not queried, displayed no relevant result, or had no material role in selecting the Woodburn location.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not exceed geographic prioritization without operation-specific query, output and decision records.

propositions.claim: ELITE individually identified M-J-M-A- before the stop.
propositions.support: The court record instead describes later plate checks, officer observations and a separate Mobile Fortify face search.
counterevidence: ELITE may have contained person or address leads relevant to the broader operation
complete operation-specific ELITE outputs remain unavailable
propositions.falsifier: An ELITE query, map output, dossier or alert names or uniquely resolves M-J-M-A- before the stop and materially informs the officer decision.
propositions.stopping_rule: Preserve the non-link unless the exact individual-identification record is acquired.

propositions.claim: ICE officers and supervisors, not Palantir, exercised the documented field authority to surveil, stop, arrest, detain and transport M-J-M-A-.
propositions.support: The judicial opinions identify the ICE team, officer observations, separate database use, arrests and detention decisions.
counterevidence: software configuration can shape what officers see and prioritize
vendor support or escalation records are not public
propositions.falsifier: A contract, workflow or support record establishes that Palantir personnel directly authorized or controlled the field action.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not convert product development or support into arrest authority without an operative record.

propositions.claim: M-J-M-A- experienced material consequence before ordinary notice or an opportunity to contest the intelligence and arrest basis.
propositions.support: The person was stopped, arrested, detained, transported and presented documents before litigation generated access to testimony, body-camera material and other records.
counterevidence: the complete administrative record and any contemporaneous supervisor review are not public
release occurred before final merits adjudication
propositions.falsifier: The complete file shows timely pre-action notice, individualized lawful findings, meaningful evidence access and an effective opportunity to prevent the material consequence.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep timing separate from the ultimate legality and merits of every claim.

propositions.claim: Judicial intervention produced observed R3 pause-and-burden-shift and R4 prospective remedy at the arrest-practice level.
propositions.support: The court granted preliminary relief and certified a class, imposing prospective limits on warrantless arrests without individualized escape-risk findings.
counterevidence: the record does not yet establish complete compliance or final merits relief
the injunction does not itself require ELITE correction, deletion, termination or compensation
propositions.falsifier: Later records show the order was stayed, reversed, evaded or produced no operative change in arrest practice.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not transfer the arrest-practice remedy into a software-governance remedy without implementation evidence.

propositions.claim: ELITE records concerning M-J-M-A- were corrected or deleted and the system was modified in response to the case.
propositions.support: The present sources identify the need for safeguards, retention, audit and correction records but do not supply the deployment-specific result.
counterevidence: Palantir publishes general auditability and privacy claims
court relief addressed arrest practices rather than the software record
propositions.falsifier: Agency and vendor records show no person-level record existed, no correctable error was found, or effective correction and deletion preceded material injury.
propositions.stopping_rule: Terminate as source-restricted or source-unavailable if lawful acquisition cannot reach the audit, retention, correction and deletion records.

propositions.claim: Palantir or ELITE was the sole cause of the stop and arrest.
propositions.support: The record contains field intelligence, plate checks, visual observation and Mobile Fortify as separate inputs, with ICE officers exercising the field decision.
counterevidence: ELITE may still have materially shaped where the operation occurred
propositions.falsifier: The complete timeline establishes that an ELITE output was indispensable and controlling, and that the action would not otherwise have occurred.
propositions.stopping_rule: Preserve contributory and sole-cause claims as different propositions.

propositions.claim: The case produced a closed error-to-learning-to-private-benefit chain for Palantir.
propositions.support: The oversight record creates an acquisition route for contracts, safeguards and retention, while Palantir describes general audit and product-governance capabilities.
counterevidence: no defect, support, model-change, payment, IP, revenue or residual-benefit record is presently joined to this person
judicial relief is directed at government arrest practice
propositions.falsifier: Complete records show no vendor learning or benefit, or any resulting benefit was matched by correction, compensation, public rights and durable accountability.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not infer extraction from deployment, litigation, revenue or product improvement alone.

current_result.strongest_supported_claim: ELITE materially informed geographic prioritization for an operation that produced direct person-level consequence before ordinary review.
current_result.strongest_preserved_non_link: ELITE is not shown to have individually identified M-J-M-A- or solely caused the stop and arrest.
current_result.largest_open_join: Exact contract, production configuration, operation-specific logs, correction, deletion, compliance and residual remedy.
